summary: Fetches any company's job openings straight from its Applicant Tracking System (ATS) via the Crawlora API — Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Personio, Recruitee, iCIMS, Oracle Recruiting, Rippling, Pinpoint, Eightfold, Gem, UKG, and Teamtailor — returning clean JSON. Use when the user wants every open role from a specific company's ATS-hosted career page, a single job posting's full detail, or a hiring-velocity snapshot for a company, given its ATS platform and company/board slug.
